scripts.test: npm run test:back && npm run test:mock && npm run type-check
scripts.lint: docker compose exec backend ruff check . && docker compose exec backend ruff format --check . && docker compose exec sources-mock ruff check .
scripts.migrate: docker compose exec backend alembic upgrade head
scripts.migration: docker compose exec backend alembic revision --autogenerate -m
scripts.seed: docker compose exec sources-mock python -m app.export /data/seed && docker compose exec backend python -m app.seed /data/seed
scripts.creer-admin: docker compose exec backend python -m app.creer_admin
